title: Biased tracers, Hybrid Effective Field Theory and Modified Gravity
efc_relevance: Extends HEFT galaxy-bias framework to f(R) with chameleon screening; supplies the bias-modeling toolkit EFC needs to interpret DESI/Euclid clustering in screened/transition regimes (L2→L3). Methodological prerequisite for any clean EFC galaxy-clustering ΔAIC.
ledger_action: Add to WP1 as HEFT methodology import; cross-reference framework:Horndeski-Deffayet2011, arXiv:2605.04154 (Phaedrus screening) and gap theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver; required follow-up: HEFT bias-table for EFC L2.
